paper.title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale

result.summary: 本文提出 Vision Transformer（ViT），将图像切分为固定大小的图像块，把线性嵌入后的图像块序列直接输入标准 Transformer 编码器进行图像分类，几乎不引入图像特有的归纳偏置 [S1.p3][S5.p1]。作者在 ImageNet、ImageNet-21k 和 JFT-300M 等不同规模数据集上预训练，并迁移到 ImageNet、CIFAR-100、VTAB 等多个基准 [S4.SS1.p1]。结果显示，在中型数据集上 ViT 略逊于同规模 ResNet，但在大规模数据预训练后，ViT 接近或超过当时的最优卷积网络，且预训练所需计算资源更少 [S1.p4][S1.p5][S4.SS2.p2]。作者认为这表明对 CNN 的依赖并非必要，纯 Transformer 直接处理图像块序列也能在图像分类任务上表现良好 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：在计算机视觉中卷积架构仍占主导，能否将标准 Transformer 直接应用于图像，而不依赖卷积网络或专门的注意力模式 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。其动机来自 Transformer 在 NLP 中的成功与可扩展性，以及此前视觉自注意力方法因使用专门注意力模式而难以在现代硬件加速器上有效扩展 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: Self-attention-based architectures, in particular Transformers, have become the model of choice in natural language processing (NLP).
In computer vision, however, convolutional architectures remain dominant.
The latter models, while theoretically efficient, have not yet been scaled effectively on modern hardware accelerators due to the use of specialized attention patterns.
Inspired by the Transformer scaling successes in NLP, we experiment with applying a standard Transformer directly to images, with the fewest possible modifications.

method.text: 方法上，ViT 将图像切分为固定大小的图像块，对每个图像块做线性嵌入并加入位置嵌入，把得到的向量序列输入标准 Transformer 编码器 [S3.F1][S3.SS1.p1]。为进行分类，模型在序列前加入一个可学习的分类 token，其编码器输出状态作为图像表示 [S3.SS1.p2]。模型设计尽量贴近原始 Transformer，只使用标准可学习的一维位置嵌入，并可在微调时对预训练位置嵌入做二维插值以适应更高分辨率 [S3.p1][S3.SS1.p3][S3.SS2.p1]。

evidence.quote: We split an image into fixed-size patches, linearly embed each of them, add position embeddings, and feed the resulting sequence of vectors to a standard Transformer encoder.
To handle 2D images, we reshape the image $\mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times C}$ into a sequence of flattened 2D patches
Similar to BERT’s [class] token, we prepend a learnable embedding to the sequence of embedded patches
In model design we follow the original Transformer as closely as possible.
We use standard learnable 1D position embeddings, since we have not observed significant performance gains from using more advanced 2D-aware position embeddings
We therefore perform 2D interpolation of the pre-trained position embeddings, according to their location in the original image.

experiments.text: 实验在 ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet（1k 类、1.3M 图像）、ImageNet-21k（21k 类、14M 图像）和 JFT（18k 类、303M 高分辨率图像）上预训练，并迁移到 ImageNet、CIFAR-10/100、Oxford-IIIT Pets、Oxford Flowers-102 以及 19 任务的 VTAB 分类套件 [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS1.p2]。模型变体基于 BERT 配置，包括 Base、Large 和新增的 Huge，并用 ViT-L/16 等记号表示模型规模与图像块大小 [S4.SS1.p3]。基线为使用 Group Normalization 和标准化卷积的 ResNet（BiT），混合模型则把 CNN 特征图输入 ViT [S4.SS1.p4]。训练使用 Adam、batch size 4096、高权重衰减 0.1，微调使用 SGD、batch size 512 [S4.SS1.p5]。

evidence.quote: we use the ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet dataset with 1k classes and 1.3M images
its superset ImageNet-21k with 21k classes and 14M images, and JFT with 18k classes and 303M high-resolution images

We transfer the models trained on these dataset to several benchmark tasks: ImageNet on the original validation labels and the cleaned-up ReaL labels, CIFAR-10/100, Oxford-IIIT Pets, and Oxford Flowers-102.
We also evaluate on the 19-task VTAB classification suite.
We base ViT configurations on those used for BERT, as summarized in Table 1.
The “Base” and “Large” models are directly adopted from BERT and we add the larger “Huge” model.
For the baseline CNNs, we use ResNet, but replace the Batch Normalization layers with Group Normalization, and used standardized convolutions.
For the hybrids, we feed the intermediate feature maps into ViT with patch size of one “pixel”.
We train all models, including ResNets, using Adam with $\beta_{1}=0.9$, $\beta_{2}=0.999$, a batch size of 4096 and apply a high weight decay of $0.1$
For fine-tuning we use SGD with momentum, batch size 512, for all models

findings.text: 在中型数据集如 ImageNet 上无强正则化训练时，ViT 的准确率比同规模 ResNet 低几个百分点 [S1.p4]。但在更大数据集（14M–300M 图像）上预训练后，ViT 接近或超过当时最优结果：最佳模型在 ImageNet 达到 88.55%、ImageNet-ReaL 达到 90.72%、CIFAR-100 达到 94.55%、VTAB 19 任务套件达到 77.63% [S1.p5]。较小的 ViT-L/16 在 JFT-300M 上预训练后，在所有任务上超过同样预训练的 BiT-L，且训练计算资源显著更少 [S4.SS2.p2]。在性能与计算权衡上，ViT 达到相同性能所需计算约为 ResNet 的 2–4 倍更少，混合模型在小计算预算下略优于纯 ViT，但差距在更大模型上消失 [S4.SS4.p2]。

evidence.quote: When trained on mid-sized datasets such as ImageNet without strong regularization, these models yield modest accuracies of a few percentage points below ResNets of comparable size.
the best model reaches the accuracy of $88.55\%$ on ImageNet, $90.72\%$ on ImageNet-ReaL, $94.55\%$ on CIFAR-100, and $77.63\%$ on the VTAB suite of 19 tasks.
The smaller ViT-L/16 model pre-trained on JFT-300M outperforms BiT-L (which is pre-trained on the same dataset) on all tasks, while requiring substantially less computational resources to train.
ViT uses approximately $2-4\times$ less compute to attain the same performance (average over 5 datasets).
hybrids slightly outperform ViT at small computational budgets, but the difference vanishes for larger models.

limitations.text: 作者指出，ViT 在较小数据集上比同计算量的 ResNet 更容易过拟合，卷积归纳偏置对较小数据集有用 [S4.SS3.p3]。自监督预训练方面，ViT-B/16 在 ImageNet 上达到 79.9%，比从头训练提升 2%，但仍落后监督预训练 4%，自监督与大规模监督预训练之间仍有较大差距 [S4.SS6.p1][S5.p2]。作者还指出，将 ViT 应用于检测、分割等其他视觉任务仍是待解决的挑战，进一步扩展 ViT 可能带来性能提升 [S5.p2]。

evidence.quote: Vision Transformers overfit more than ResNets with comparable computational cost on smaller datasets.
This result reinforces the intuition that the convolutional inductive bias is useful for smaller datasets
our smaller ViT-B/16 model achieves 79.9% accuracy on ImageNet, a significant improvement of 2% to training from scratch, but still 4% behind supervised pre-training.
One is to apply ViT to other computer vision tasks, such as detection and segmentation.
Our initial experiments show improvement from self-supervised pre-training, but there is still large gap between self-supervised and large-scale supervised pre-training.
Finally, further scaling of ViT would likely lead to improved performance.
